غَضْبَى fem. of غَضْبَانُ [q. v.]: (S, Msb, K:) and pl. thereof. (S.) [See also غَضُوبٌ.] ＝
-A2- It is also said by J, (K, TA,) and [before him] by EzZejjájee, and also [after him] by ISd, (TA,) to be a name for A hundred camels, and not to have tenween, nor the article ال: but this is a mistake for غَضْيَا. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
